verdict.rationale: Nitrokey is a hardware security key and HSM family: FIDO2, OTP, OpenPGP smart card, PIV and encrypted storage, plus the nitropy CLI for managing devices. A built-in, task-delegating AI assistant is outside this product category, and nothing in the evidence shows the product or its companion tools shipping one, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
